subject: Request: Senior approval for Hosted API rate variance — Emerald Health
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Emerald Health asks for deep hosted discount — need senior OK

Team,

Quick summary from this morning's call with Emerald (Paul & Lisa): they want to move from a pilot to production and have asked for a 28% off list rate for Hosted API usage to match a competitor they evaluated. Their projected 12-month consumption if they convert is ~1.4M tokens/month (peak ramp in q3). Current list is $0.0025/token; 28% would get them to ~$0.0018 — that is beyond our delegated discount band (>20%).

Options I suggested on the call:
- Option A (preferred from my side): 25% off list for 12 months in exchange for a 1.2M token monthly committed minimum (12-month term) + 30% discount on eval env calls for first 30 days.
- Option B (customer asks): 28% off with a 12-mo commit and a soft cap on overage pricing (we'd log a one-time credit if they breach ramp).

Risks / notes:
- This account is in healthcare (PHI surface discussion pending). We need SOC2 evidence and Private deployment conversation is ongoing but not required for initial rollout.
- Revenue math: Option A (25%) with commit yields ~$2.7M ARR over 12 months vs Option B (28%) ~$2.6M — the incremental delta is small but Option B sets a precedent.

Attachments: I pushed the usage forecast and a proposed MOP with terms for the rep.

Ask: I need senior approval to provide >20% off (this is at least 25% in our counter). Please approve or suggest alternate guardrails (credits, consumption caps, probation period).

Thanks,
Ben

-- 
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Emerald Health asks for deep hosted discount — need senior OK

Ben — thanks for the clear summary. A couple of thoughts before we elevate: 

1) Precedent: We should avoid a straight percentage deeper than 25% unless there's a multi-year lock or strategic partner clause.
2) Structure: Prefer a commitment + true-up credit rather than an unconditional flat discount. If they hit the committed MOU we table the discount; if they miss, we invoice at a higher rate and provide a small reconciliation credit.
3) Compliance: Before granting anything >20%, ensure Security has confirmed SOC2 + Data Retention posture (Marissa, please flag to SecOps).

If we go with a 25% concession, we should add: a) a 12-month committed monthly minimum (1.2M tokens/mo), b) a termination clause tied to non-payment, and c) a one-time onboarding credit capped at $15k.

If everyone is aligned I will sign off and we'll ask for a one-time senior exception on the discount band.

Jonas

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Paul Rice <paul.rice@emerald.health>, Lisa Huang <lisa.huang@emerald.health>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Next steps & proposal for Hosted API production rollout

Paul / Lisa —

Thanks again for the call. We appreciate the urgency to scale. Based on our discussion, here's a proposal we can take to our leadership for approval: 

- Commercial: 25% off list rate for Hosted API consumption for 12 months in exchange for a 1.2M token/month committed minimum. Overages billed at list with a quarterly reconciliation credit if they exceed the commit by >20% (safety valve for ramp).
- Onboarding: one-time $15k credit for migration and test traffic, applied to month 1 invoice.
- Term: 12 months, auto-renew unless either party notifies 60 days before renewal.
- Compliance: SOC2 evidence required prior to production data; we will provide SOC2 Type II and the security questionnaire by EOD Wednesday.

This counters your ask (28%) and preserves an acceptable revenue profile while granting a significant concession. We do need one-time senior approval on our side to offer a discount beyond the standard 20% band. I'll follow up after I get internal sign-off — plan is to come back with a signed headcount/commitment and final MOP.

Attachments: usage forecast and the proposed MOP (for reference).

Would you be open to signing a Letter of Intent with the commit terms this week so we can lock pricing pending internal approval?

Best,
Ben

-- 
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: ACTION: Requesting senior approval for Emerald Health hosted discount (DL-9842)

Aditya —

Summary and ask in bullet form to make this quick: 
- Account: Emerald Health (prospect -> pilot)
- Ask: One-time authorization to allow a 25% off-list discount on Hosted API consumption for 12 months in exchange for a 1.2M token/mo committed minimum (deal id DL-9842). This exceeds our 20% delegated authority.
- Revenue impact: Estimated ARR with commit = ~$2.7M; delta vs list = ~$900k loss vs list pricing but acceptable given strategic ramp potential.
- Conditions we propose upon approval: SOC2 evidence provided before production; one-time $15k onboarding credit; quarterly true-up & overage reconciliation; 60-day auto-renew notification; clause to protect against precedent (deal marked as "exception - non-precedent").
- Attachments: usage forecast, proposed MOP (see links and attached files).

Risks: precedent setting and healthcare regulatory surface. Controls to mitigate: short term 12-mo duration, explicit non-precedent language, compliance gating before live data.

Request: Approve / Deny / Modify. If approved, please reply with explicit "approve 25%" so I can finalize the LOI and have Ben send the formal proposal to Paul.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
